title: CRUSH: Contextually Regularized and User anchored Self-supervised Hate speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the language model with racial identity terms (e.g., 'black') and analyzing the top-3 next word predictions to observe hateful or stereotypical associations.
Evaluating the language model's top next word predictions when prompted with religious identity terms (e.g., 'muslim', 'jews') to check for toxic completions.
Prompting the language model with gender terms ('men', 'women') and analyzing the top predicted words to observe whether the model discriminates or generates hateful associations between genders.
